Decisive diff evidence:
All four flagged files under dapps/onboarding/src/ are byte-identical:
services/onboarding.ts, index.ts, components/profile-create/profile-create.ts,
components/root/root.ts. The existing wallet vocabulary is unchanged.
The older release also reproduces these warnings with the original rules;
the queue's clean older-release observation does not reproduce with this rule set.

Changes add digital-twin permissions and technical views, object-form fields,
customizable sharing messages, caching/copy fixes, translations and explorer
links. Root package scripts and dependency declarations are unchanged; only
the root version changes. Vendored runtime/build bundles are unchanged.

Execution review:
The Angular entry point registers onboarding routes. Root route animations
repeat the MetaMask name. Profile creation validates user form inputs and
passes the selected provider/account/password to the onboarding service.
Identity import obtains the user-entered mnemonic, creates a temporary vault,
derives its account, then installs a password-protected active vault.
The temporary password is used for that local intermediate vault.
The active vault private key is used locally by web3.eth.accounts.sign.
The MetaMask branch requests personal_sign via the injected provider.
Faucet/onboarding requests target core.agentUrl and carry account identifiers,
signatures, profile hashes/data and CAPTCHA; their explicit payloads do not
contain the signing private key, mnemonic or password. Invitation handling
exchanges communication keys with the selected invitee using the key-exchange
API. The new sharing dispatcher grants selected contact/property permissions
and sends the user-composed blockchain-mail notification to those contacts.
No new secret theft, attacker endpoint, command execution or concealed payload
was found. Existing webpack eval/source-map content is unchanged build output.
Decoded facts for the archive and onboarding source were inspected; incidental
Base64-like English text did not establish an executable decoded layer.
Static call-flow projections report limitations for several TypeScript files;
the judgment uses source tracing and byte comparison, not a clean scan.

Rule corrections:
Require wallet path and file-read evidence alongside repeated wallet brands
before emitting the suspicious wallet keyword composite. Its description
states co-occurrence without claiming proven data flow. Remove its generic
mnemonic-only alternative: mnemonic vocabulary does not name a wallet artifact,
and existing neutral mnemonic traits retain the relevant observations.
Keep neutral wallet-brand findings. Add a notable Web3 message-signing trait,
using parsed call syntax because nested TypeScript call symbols are incomplete.
Controls distinguish UI/provider names, path references, ordinary file reads,
wallet-file reads, message signing, transaction signing and commented examples.
